summary: Indian stocks opened sharply higher after the holiday, delivering the gap-up the pre-open cues pointed to, as cheaper oil lifted sentiment and added broadly to market value.

detail.leaders: Broad buying at the open, led by cheaper oil
detail.laggards: No clear laggard group reported in the first minutes
detail.tone: A read of the live market just after the open. The start matched the strong pre-open signal rather than the softer Wall Street lead, though no sector or stock breakdown was out yet.
watch: Whether the opening gain holds or fades into mid-morning
Crude staying near its two-month lows
Reaction to Tata Power and other results due today
